notes: thing was read as the article's supplied nominal under rule 102 rather than as part of parathekes own English, the article taking That … thing and heading on the nominal; reading it with the noun remains defensible.

tou before enoikountos is unrepresented because the article governs the expressed head noun pneumatos, so the relativizer is the participle's helper (rules 23, 31). This is the reading 1:9 must match.
